title: The Foreman runs its own watcher and wakes at worst every 55 minutes
summary: Specified (Q1 option B): Claude Code steering wake 55m by default, a Foreman watcher on its batch's merge, red-CI and wait-met lines, AGENTS.md watcher rule rewritten. After watcher-limit and CR-471. Four open questions, the first on who records a user's merge.
